description: Implementation of a data access object (DAO) for managing Group entities, including methods for querying groups by permissions, IDs, and group type within a Spring-based Java application using JPA.

classes.name: GroupDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for performing database operations related to Group entities, extending generic DAO functionality and implementing GroupDao interface.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects associated with specified permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects matching a set of IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by GroupType.
